verdict.rationale: The evidence shows ImageMagick's source is publicly readable. It has an official GitHub repository, is written in C, and documents configure-script build options. Community comments mention inspecting its commit history and making your own build. However, nothing in the pack names the license or confirms it is an open-source license. missing for 10: explicit statement of the open-source license (e.g., license name/terms), first-party documentation of source distribution terms.
